India Rejects Monopolies, Minister Responds to Elon Musk

Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia stated that India does not permit monopolies, responding to claims made by Elon Musk regarding satellite communications. Scindia's remarks were presented as a rebuttal to Musk's assertions.
